findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Test — The test sets the pin to the version of the Forge executable under test for both new and adopted clients. It would still pass if sync incorrectly rewrote forge.toml to that executable's version, so it does not prove the promised pin preservation during an upgrade. It also omits the named Forge-source repo case.
